verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing page gives $20 in credits on sign-up plus $10 in credits every month, with no payment method required, which directly supports prototyping for free (exa-docs-34). A community user confirms signing up for a trial account and testing the search API (exa-comm-1), and the MCP server needs no API key to get started (exa-docs-31). Missing for 10: documented free-tier rate limits or usage caps (exa-docs-16 mentions default rate limits but gives no free-tier specifics).
